title: ARC-3 decision step, corpus v0
description: One record per decision point. Shape is fixed by docs/trace-findings/2026-09-14-decision-step-corpus-v0-plan.md section 6. Frames are referenced by (recording_guid, row_index, field) and are never inlined as pixels.

schema_version.description: 0.2. Adding a value to a closed enum does not bump this: every record already written stays valid, and validate.py rejects an unknown value either way, so a reader pinned to an older version cannot silently mis-read a record of it. Commit 73f512415 set that precedent (episode_start, extent_change). Adding, removing or retyping a FIELD does bump it, and 0.2 is that bump: last_result.run_ended. 0.1 reserved 0.2 for the per-game boundary_reason redesign; that reservation is released rather than quietly ignored, because run_ended arrived first and versions are cheaper than the confusion of two meanings for one number. The redesign takes the next one.

tier.description: gold = observational human/researcher replay; silver = source-verified synthetic trajectory; negative = failed probe paired with a corrected next decision.

game_id.description: Opaque game id, e.g. bp35-0a0ad940. Never a readable title.

kind.description: Provenance of the trajectory this step was cut from. Only 'human_replay' is pinned by the plan.

boundary_reason.description: Why the segment boundary was cut here. The plan section 5 step 4 boundary list, plus episode_start (the recording begins here, no preceding state change), level_advance (the previous row completed a level - levels_completed rose, 15-Sep-2026) and extent_change (a held or selected part changed extent rather than orientation - cn04, 15-Sep-2026).

level.description: Level the decision was taken on.

frame_ref.description: Reference to the observed frame. Resolves to line row_index of datasets/decision-steps/v0/recordings/<game_id>/<recording_guid>.ndjson.

field.description: Name of the field on that NDJSON row that carries the frame.

ascii.description: Optional ASCII rendering of the frame. null when not materialised.

memory_in.description: Structured memory carried into the decision.

last_action.description: The action taken immediately before the observed frame. null on a turn-0 record — the first decision of an episode, where nothing preceded it. Required either way: the annotator writes null on purpose, so a forgotten field still errors. last_result must be null whenever this is.
last_action.$comment: Nullability is expressed with a type array, the same way 'ascii' already does it in this document, so validate.py's fixed-keyword evaluator needs no new keyword and its unsupported-keyword audit stays intact. The if/then wrapper is here only because the object form is a $ref: $ref is evaluated independently of a sibling type, so a bare type array would still fail the ref on null.

last_result.description: What the action before the observed frame changed. null on a turn-0 record, where last_action is null too.

run_ended.description: Did that action end the run - a death, or a final GAME_OVER the board does not come back from. Added in 0.2 because without it a post-death record reads exactly like an ordinary step, and a corpus whose whole purpose is recovery after being wrong could not say that the player had just been killed. Required rather than optional on purpose: an omitted flag defaults to the reading that loses the signal, which is the failure this field exists to end.

decision.description: What was actually done at this step.

corrected_decision.description: What should have been done. Required on tier 'negative'.

observed.description: What the next frame actually showed.

action_role.description: What the action was for, e.g. 'falsification probe'.

action_role_source.description: Citation into the game source backing action_role. Form '<path>:<line>' with optional trailing note.

rationale_provenance.description: Replays carry no think channel; v0 rationales are attached retrospectively by the annotator.

allOf.$comment: Turn 0 is both-or-neither. A null last_action with a non-null last_result (or the reverse) describes a step that both did and did not have a predecessor, which is not a record of anything.

rowIndex.description: Zero-based line index into the NDJSON recording.

actionName.description: Engine action name. ACTION7 included per PR #9 (commit d5339da).

args.description: Click coordinates. Present only for actions that take a cell.

memoryDelta.description: Partial memory update. Same keys as memory_in, all optional, none invented.

rationale.description: Short and falsifiable. Must be contradictable by the next frame.

expected_observation.description: The concrete thing the next frame either confirms or refutes.
